dynamic_headers_by_gang_month_optimized.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.DocDesc FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POTONGAN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE 'POT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POT %' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%DEDUCT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%CUTI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%IZIN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%DENDA%') AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%ASTEK%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%PREMI%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BPJS%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%KESEHATAN%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%PENSIUN%' AND t.DocDesc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.DocDesc

dynamic_headers_by_gang_month_with_amoun.sql: SELECT t.DocDesc, SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) AS TotalAmount FROM PR_ADTRANS_ARC AS t JOIN PR_ADTRANSLN_ARC AS ln ON t.ID = ln.MasterID JOIN HR_GANGLN AS g ON g.GangMember = t.EmpCode WHERE g.GangCode = ? AND t.DocDate >= ? AND t.DocDate < ? AND (UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POTONGAN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE 'POT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%POT %' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%DEDUCT%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%CUTI%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%IZIN%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%DENDA%' OR UPPER(t.DocDesc) LIKE '%PPH%') AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%ASTEK%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%PREMI%' AND UPPER(t.DocDesc) NOT LIKE '%BPJS%' GROUP BY t.DocDesc HAVING SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ln.Amount,0)) DESC
